label: O2 mole fraction
description: Oxidizer O2 mole fraction. For CFI-G and Flame Design inverse flames it is the burner jet, not the ambient.

label: CO2 mole fraction
description: Ambient CO2 mole fraction (suppressant in FLEX).

label: He mole fraction
description: Ambient helium mole fraction (diluent in FLEX and CFI).

label: Fuel mole fraction
description: Fuel mole fraction in the fuel stream (or in the ambient for inverse flames).

label: Extinction diameter
description: Droplet diameter when the visible flame went out.

label: Adiabatic flame temperature
description: Computed adiabatic flame temperature (R13: not an observation).

label: Stoichiometric mixture fraction
description: Computed stoichiometric mixture fraction (R13: not an observation).

label: Peak burner temperature
description: Peak temperature measured at the burner.

label: Burned length in 1 g
description: Sample length burned in the ground (1 g) reference test (SAFFIRE-II).

label: Flame spread rate in 1 g
description: Flame spread rate in the ground reference test (SAFFIRE-II).

label: Final O2 mole fraction
description: O2 mole fraction at the end of the test.

label: Final CO2 mole fraction
description: CO2 mole fraction at the end of the test.

label: Initial CO
description: CO concentration at the start of the test.

label: Final CO
description: CO concentration at the end of the test (combustion product).

label: Mass loss rate
description: Mass loss rate of the heated sample (SAME).

label: Net aging time
description: Total smoke aging time (SAME and SAME-R).

label: Wire resistance ratio Rt/R0
description: Heater wire resistance ratio (how hot the wire got) in SAME-R.
